collection.title: Smart ForTwo Cabrio 2014 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Smart ForTwo Cabrio 2014 Onwards will fit, this model requires a 20" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 14" for the passengers side. This model uses the Bayonet arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade

image.alt: Smart ForTwo Cabrio 2014 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
